title: FlowMap-OPD: Rollout--Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators
abstract: arXiv:2609.37851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-step flow-map generators, including MeanFlow and consistency models, enable efficient sampling through long-range transport, yet their on-policy distillation remains underexplored. We introduce FlowMap-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework that separates student-state acquisition from teacher--student distribution comparison. A formulation based on state marginals establishes this separation, while flow--velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed long-range map. Within this framework, we develop flow-map, induced-velocity, and instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, each paired with a separately specified native flow-map rollout. Cross-capacity ImageNet experiments across three teacher rewards identify instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice. translated_title: FlowMap-OPD：面向少步流映射生成器在线策略蒸馏的展开-核分离方法
translated_abstract: 少步流映射生成器（包括 MeanFlow 和一致性模型）能够通过长程传输实现高效采样，但其在线策略蒸馏仍未得到充分研究。我们提出了 FlowMap-OPD，这是一个在线策略蒸馏框架，它将学生状态的获取与师生分布比较分离开来。基于状态边缘分布的公式化确立了这种分离，而流-速度一致性则将局部监督与部署的长程映射联系起来。在该框架内，我们开发了流映射、诱导速度和瞬时速度分布监督，每种监督均与单独指定的原生流映射展开相配对。在跨容量的 ImageNet 实验中，针对三种教师奖励的对比表明，带有独立可调学生一致性的瞬时速度分布监督是最有效的选择。在文生图实验中，FlowMap-OPD 展现出强大的多特化能力。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 FlowMap-OPD 在线策略蒸馏框架，通过展开-核分离将学生状态获取与师生分布比较解耦，并通过实验证明带独立可调学生一致性的瞬时速度分布监督是最有效的蒸馏方案。
en_tdlr: FlowMap-OPD introduces an on-policy distillation framework with rollout-kernel separation that decouples student-state acquisition from teacher-student distribution comparison, and identifies instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice.
